phase: ROADMAP Stage 4: deterministic DOCX render/layout regression v1 (structural/markup regression over the generated OOXML package; visual screenshots remain future work). Docs-finalization rework pass; implementation unchanged.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only DOCX render/layout regression slice. inspect_docx_package_layout opens a generated DOCX byte package and reports which parts are present (document/styles/footer), the distinct paragraph style ids referenced, footer PAGE-field presence, and the page size / margins declared in the section properties. build_docx_layout_regression_report exports a DOCX in-memory, inspects it, and cross-checks against the style profile and existing preflight helpers (table / attachment / unknown-font counts), emitting an ordered list of named pass/fail checks plus a rollup summary. No real renderer is bundled or invoked; visual screenshot / pixel layout regression is explicitly documented as future work. export_docx behavior is unchanged.
implemented: backend/server.py: added inspect_docx_package_layout(raw_docx) returning method=docx_package_layout_inspector_v1, readable_zip, parts, has_document/has_styles/has_footer, footer_has_page_field, style_references, and page size/margins parsed from the section properties.

backend/server.py: added build_docx_layout_regression_report(title, body, style_profile=None) returning method=docx_layout_regression_v1, passed, package_size_bytes, inspection, an ordered checks[] list (zip_readable, document_present, styles_present, footer_matches_page_number, footer_has_page_field, {title,heading,body}_style_referenced, page_size_present, margins_present), failed_checks, and a summary with table/attachment/unknown-font/paragraph counts.

tests/test_docx_layout_regression.py: 9 unit tests covering the inspector (parts, footer on/off, style references, invalid bytes) and the regression report (all-pass default, structured/font counts, footer flag tracking, JSON serializability).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: py-compile gate now includes tests/test_docx_layout_regression.py.
README.md and docs/ROADMAP.md document the v1 boundary; the ROADMAP 'DOCX 渲染截图与版式回归' item is marked done as structural regression v1 with visual screenshots noted as future work.

risks: The inspector matches the section properties via a fixed regex over the known export template; if export_docx's sectPr markup changes, the regex would need updating (a regression test would surface this).
This is structural/markup regression only: it can confirm parts, style references, page size, and margins exist and match the profile, but cannot detect visual rendering defects.
Style-reference checks are conditional on a role actually appearing in the layout plan, so an all-body document does not assert title/heading references.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
